title: Aggregate renderer site configuration
description: Shape of site.json at the workspace root, the single configuration file the build reads.

name.description: Organization whose repositories are scanned for the doc-target property.

tokenEnvVar.description: Name of the environment variable holding the token. The token value is never part of this file.

directory.description: Directory holding the aggregate output tree, relative to the configuration file or absolute.

reportPath.description: Path of the build report JSON, relative to the configuration file or absolute.

cacheDirectory.description: Directory holding reused rendering work, relative to the configuration file or absolute.

hostname.description: Bare host used for every public address and written to the site address file. No scheme, no slash.

strategy.description: Version decision implementation. Both produce identical output for the same corpus.

map.description: Template name to file path. A site replaces commondoc::document here with no code change. Names absent from the map use the shared renderer default.
